meta.name: senior-frontend
meta.description: Frontend development skill for React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS applications. Use when building React components, optimizing Next.js performance, analyzing bundle sizes, scaffolding frontend projects, implementing accessibility, or reviewing frontend code quality.

copy.tagline: 构建高性能 React 前端应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在用 React 或 Next.js 构建前端应用
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build frontend apps with React or Next.js

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能生成 React/Next.js 项目模板、创建带测试和 Storybook 的组件、分析包体积并推荐替代库、提供 React 模式代码和 Next.js 优化建议，以及检查可访问性。
howto.when: 当你要求搭建前端项目、生成组件、分析依赖包体积、优化 Next.js 性能或审查代码可访问性时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Next.js 14 脚手架创建一个新项目，包含认证和测试功能。
say.note: Claude 会生成项目目录结构和配置文件。

say.text: 分析我的 package.json，找出可以替换的臃肿依赖。
say.note: Claude 会列出大包及其替代方案。

say.text: 生成一个带测试和 Storybook 的客户端按钮组件。
say.note: Claude 会输出组件代码、测试文件和故事。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can scaffold Next.js/React projects, generate components with tests and Storybook, analyze bundle size and suggest alternatives, provide React patterns and Next.js optimization tips, and check accessibility.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to scaffold a frontend project, generate components, analyze dependencies, optimize Next.js performance, or review accessibility.

say_en.text: Scaffold a new Next.js 14 project with auth and testing features.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the project structure and config files.

say_en.text: Analyze my package.json for heavy dependencies to replace.
say_en.note: Claude will list large packages and alternatives.

say_en.text: Generate a client button component with tests and Storybook.
say_en.note: Claude will output component code, test, and story.
